Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning actions for trespass upon a business owner's premises.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to actions for trespass upon a business owner'spremises; adding a new section to chapter 4.24 RCW; and prescribingpenalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A business owner has a cause of action for trespass against anyperson who enters or remains unlawfully upon the business owner'spremises. (2) In any action under subsection (1) of this section, a businessowner may recover actual damages or elect to recover, without proof ofspecial damages, the amount of twentyfive hundred dollars asliquidated damages. (3) If a business owner prevails in an action under subsection (1)of this section, the business owner is entitled to recover reasonableattorneys' fees and legal expenses. Such expenses are not confined tothe costs allowed under RCW 4.84.010. (4) If a person alleged to have trespassed on a business owner's p. 1 HB 2353premises prevails in an action under subsection (1) of this section, heor she may recover attorneys' fees only if the action is frivolouswithin the meaning of RCW 4.84.185.
